question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Hapily". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hapily** is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Happily".**
 
• **Happily **means in a joyful or contented manner, with a sense of happiness or satisfaction. (ख़ुशी या संतुष्टि की भावना के साथ, हर्षित या संतुष्ट तरीके से)
 
 
• **Example**: *She finished her project ahead of schedule and happily celebrated her success with friends and family.*
 
 
 
• Always remember, when a word ends in **'y', **and we want to add **'ly' **to make it an adverb, the **'y' **changes to **'i' **before adding **'ly', **(happy => happily).

So, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Quickly**' is an adverb derived from the adjective 'quick' by adding 'ly' at the end. It means at a fast pace or with speed. (तीव्र गति से या वेग से)
 
• '**Bravely**' is an adverb derived from the adjective 'brave' by adding 'ly' at the end. It means courageously or with bravery. (साहसपूर्वक या बहादुरी के साथ)
 
• '**Slowly**' is an adverb derived from the adjective 'slow' by adding 'ly' at the end. It means at a slow pace or with reduced speed. (धीमी गति से)
